item.text: {"explanation":"Maintains the current clock and queued jobs in insertion order. Expired jobs are removed before every event and immediately after advancing. Adds require an unused queued ID, a deadline strictly after now, and sufficient capacity. Runs select the earliest deadline, preserving insertion order on ties; cancellation and capacity accounting update the queue accordingly.","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,jobs:[]},now=s.now,jobs=s.jobs.slice();const expire=()=>{jobs=jobs.filter(j=>j.deadline>now)};expire();let status,ran=null;if(event.type==='add'){let bytes=0,used=false;for(let j of jobs){bytes+=j.size;if(j.id===event.id)used=true}if(used||event.deadline<=now||bytes+event.size>config.capacity)status='rejected';else{jobs.push({id:event.id,size:event.size,deadline:event.deadline});status='accepted'}}else if(event.type==='cancel'){let k=jobs.findIndex(j=>j.id===event.id);if(k<0)status='missing';else{jobs.splice(k,1);status='cancelled'}}else if(event.type==='advance'){now+=event.dt;expire();status='advanced'}else{if(!jobs.length)status='empty';else{let k=0;for(let i=1;i<jobs.length;i++)if(jobs[i].deadline<jobs[k].deadline)k=i;ran=jobs[k].id;jobs.splice(k,1);status='ran'}}let bytes=0;for(let j of jobs)bytes+=j.size;return{state:{now:now,jobs:jobs},output:{status:status,ran:ran,pending:jobs.map(j=>j.id),bytes:bytes,now:now}}}"}
